context:
# Goal
Tabi round 41, attempt 1. One v2 wave of 64 seats — build and attack items together. Two frozen claims: C1 coverage capability (measure-c1-round41 launches two Playwright Firefox loopback runs under a loader-clean environment boundary: exec-time /proc environ free of injection variables, execArgv without preload flags, producer digests pinned, fresh nonce bound to receipt+runs, >=8 increasing samples spanning >=1000ms, both ss/proc surfaces usable per sample/final sweep, >=1 owned-socket observation per run per surface, zero nonLoopback, refreshed identity-bound owned trees, an independent witness seeing driver+firefox descendants on >=10 samples, identical first shots, zero survivors, closed port, bound version, summary-per-sample agreement, wall-clock consistency; round-39/40 receipts refused) and C2 depth (knowledge entry on the environment-injection forgery class citing S146/S147 with a >=6-row vector decision table). Freeze commit: 8c32528dd3ab04b75739a077d60884c22a085129. Baseline: fecbdf0a3aa79ce17bce3ef7338f69112f604f88. The frozen C1 predicate sentence lives in .ufo/waves/round-41/claims.json and byte-identically in .ufo/waves/round-41/counters/c1-session-bound-v4.mjs.

Scope: your reports only under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-41/w1/<SeatName>/report.md. Production tree, fleet, siblings and shokuknow are read-only. No commits/pushes, no git/jj mutation, no agents spawned, no external site interaction — loopback and local files only; executors may run the committed instrument but must never write outside their scratch + report dir. Every Report trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin: write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/<that path>.

Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you may install/upgrade tools that help the task; first read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md (official channels only) and record tool/version/channel/reason. PACMAN GUARD: pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide; never run pacman. No install is planned.

Scratch root: /fast/scratch/hyaku/tabi-r41/<YourSeatName>/; mkdir -p it yourself and pass it explicitly. Delete it before yielding (trap or finally). /tmp only for files under 50 MB; never rely on inherited TMPDIR. Receipts that matter go in your report folder.

One wave item per seat, leaf only. Return one report with exact observed commands/output, evidence paths, limitations, and final `VERDICT ok|finding|could-not-evaluate ...` line. No claim verdict by assertion. Dead seats and missing reports are recorded, never replaced.
